meta.title: INDEX 350 — W4 Performance Review & W5 Candidate Selection
meta.policy: This batch reviews W4 only when real finalized GSC/indexation outputs exist. It never fabricates metrics and never publishes W5 candidates.

composition.note: W5 closes all remaining Condition and B2B candidates, plus 15 district-first Local pages. Exact composition is required for selection-ready status; do not weaken quality gates to force 40.

selectionRules: Only HOLD_PLANNED candidates from D_CONDITION, E_B2B, and F_LOCAL are eligible for W5.
Real W4 Observation state ROUND5_REVIEW_ELIGIBLE is required before SELECT decisions are emitted.
Every W5 candidate parent must already be LIVE.
All 5 remaining Condition candidates are preferred to close the condition expansion without Model×Condition cartesian pages.
All 20 B2B candidates are preferred because they share the governed bulk-sale hub but own distinct organization/workflow intent.
Local selection is district-first; no local candidate may claim a physical branch or fake address.
Brand×District, Series×District, and Model×District pages remain prohibited.
No candidate is published, indexed, added to sitemap, or canonicalized by this batch.
No automatic W5 release, merge, redirect, noindex, or canonical switch.
